item.title: AI Agent Workflow Builder Statistics (November 2026)
item.description: On 2026-11-27, n8n had the most GitHub stars of the 8 AI agent workflow builders we checked (212,368). Dify had 161,980 and Langflow 156,985. Only three of the eight have a package we could count: n8n and Flowise on npm, and Langflow on PyPI. These workflow builder statistics were collected by aiagentmemory.org from the GitHub REST API, pypistats.org and the npm registry on 2026-11-27 at 07:10 UTC. We did not run any of these tools ourselves.
